description: Land Acquisition - Pethangalla, Rideegama D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains a ministerial order directing the taking of possession of specific land parcels, detailed descriptions of the land locations, boundaries, and extents. While it mentions a minister's name and title, the core content focuses entirely on land matters (acquisition and property descriptions), making it a Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
